subject: Rail Ombudsman
summary: Once 40 working days have passed since complaining to the operator, or sooner on a final response (a deadlock letter, email or text) the person is unhappy with. Delay and cancellation disputes are in scope; it is free, and its decision binds the operator if the person accepts it. Within 12 months of the operator’s final response, unless circumstances are exceptional.
